description_expanded: Description Description 30A Beach House Rental, Après 30A Villa, by Panhandle Getaways, is a spacious 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom beach house in Seacrest Beach, Florida. Enjoy access to the resort-style community pool along with close proximity to the beach, shopping, dining, and the neighboring communities of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach. FEATURES• 30A Beach House - Seacrest Beach, FL• Spacious Balconies and Outdoor Seating Areas• Living Area with 65" Smart TV • Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar • Dining Area• Bedroom 1 - King Bed, Balcony Access, 55" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom• Bedroom 2 - Queen Bed, Patio Access, 50" Smart TV• Bathroom 2 - Tub/Shower Combo• Bedroom 3 - 2 Queen Beds, Balcony Access, 50" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom• Bedroom 4 - King Bed, Balcony Access, 50" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom• Full Size Washer and Dryer• Complimentary High-Speed Wi-Fi• Sleeps 10 30A Beach Access Points ABOUT SEACREST BEACH Located along Scenic Highway 30A near Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach is one of the most desirable communities on Florida’s Emerald Coast. Known for its laid-back atmosphere and unbeatable location, Seacrest offers guests easy access to shopping, dining, and entertainment while still maintaining a relaxed coastal feel. The nearby Village of South Walton features local boutiques, restaurants, seasonal events, and 30A’s only Starbucks. Guests also enjoy access to the impressive 12,000-square-foot lagoon-style community pool and miles of scenic biking and walking trails. WHY GUESTS LOVE 30A • Family-Friendly Beaches and Activities• Walkable and Bike-Friendly Communities• Scenic 17-Mile Bike Trail Along 30A• Boutique Shopping and Art Galleries• Local Dining, Food Trucks, and Wine Festivals• Fishing, Golf, and Outdoor Adventures• Charming Coastal Town Atmosphere BONUS***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: • 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round• 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round• 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) ADDITIONAL INFORMATION• Seacrest amenity fees of $3 per person, per day, will be collected after booking. • A starter set of toiletries, paper products, and detergents is provided for your arrival. Guests should plan to purchase additional supplies for the remainder of their stay. Linens and bath towels are provided; please bring beach towels for outdoor use.• Exterior security cameras are located on the property for safety purposes. Read more
